text:
maria: Hey team — partner AcmeEdge reported a batch where 3k devices sent '0' sku_id in the payload. marketplace accepted the event but entitlements didn't attach. Need a quick mitigation and a recon plan.
raj: ugh. Is this the new gateway build 2.1 that strips device metadata when offline?
ellie: our ledger shows daily consumption is lower than partner-reported by ~45k token-units for 2025-06-09. could be this mapping.
maria: yes, partner says devices queued while offline, then batched up with minimal headers. they still include usage_count and timestamp but no sku_id.
henry: possible short-term mitigation: treat missing sku_id as 'unknown_partner_default' and apply provisional entitlements with a hold flag. then reconcile once partner backfills.
raj: agree. implement a retry-queue worker that: 1) marks missing-sku events, 2) tries to enrich via device_lookup service, 3) if still missing after 24h, apply provisional mapping for billing with audit tag.
ellie: provisional mapping sounds ok but we need credits policy and customer-facing wording. propose: provisional credit = 0, post-reconcile we either charge or issue off-cycle credit depending on mapping confidence. escalate to finance for threshold.
maria: partner asks for automated webhook when we apply provisional entitlements so they can backfill on their side. we should also rate-limit to avoid noisy alerts.
raj: adding a quick test webhook payload for their QA:
```
POST /marketplace/webhooks/usage-enrich
{
  "event_id": "evt_123",
  "device_id": "dev-01",
  "reported_usage": 1200,
  "sku_id": null,
  "observed_at": "2025-06-09T23:17:00Z"
}
```
henry: ops note — lock the ledger namespace for the rollforward window to avoid concurrent writes. naive approach: set lease on namespace: `ledger.lock(namespace, ttl=600)` during reconcile job.
ellie: also need a reconciliation playbook: steps -> identify affected batches, run enrichment, produce a mapping confidence score, apply provisional entitlements, generate off-cycle credit file if mapping_confidence < 0.6, notify partner, then after partner backfill re-run and settle.
maria: I'm drafting the playbook. assignment: raj to build retry-queue worker, henry to add the ledger lock/lease, ellie to draft finance policy and notify partner comms, and I'll coordinate partner QA.
raj: ETA 48h to get a basic worker in staging (will add metrics: `usage.enrich.missing_sku`, `usage.enrich.backfilled_count`, `usage.enrich.provisional_applied`).
henry: I'll add a small SLO exception for the ledger namespace and create a runbook entry in eng-oncall.
ellie: finance: will draft threshold matrix and sample customer note. can we cap provisional charge to 5% of daily usage until fully reconciled?
maria: good start. two more asks: 1) we need a short SQL to find affected customers for the last 7 days, 2) a lightweight dashboard tile for partner-facing seats. raj, can you drop the SQL?
raj: SQL to find suspect batches: 
```
SELECT partner_id, batch_id, count(*) as events, sum(usage_count) as total_tokens
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE sku_id IS NULL
  AND received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY partner_id, batch_id
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
ellie: perfect. I'll cross-ref with ledger entries and pull the customer list.
maria: partner-side ask: they want us to backfill automatically if device_lookup returns a single high-confidence sku. are we comfortable auto-applying if confidence >= 0.9?
raj: yes, auto-apply if confidence >= 0.9, provisional if 0.6-0.9, hold and notify if <0.6. will add to worker.
henry: can someone add a short alert spike rule: if `usage.enrich.provisional_applied` increases by >500% in 10m, page eng oncall.
maria: will add to monitoring ticket. final: Ellie — prepare partner-facing note with clear list of what triggers a credit vs charge and how they backfill. aim to send in 24h.
ellie: on it. I'll post draft here when ready. :thumbsup:
saturn-bot: Scheduled job 'backfill-orchestrator' created: id bf-20250610-01, owner raj, runs in staging at 2025-06-10T02:00:00Z.
maria: thanks all — we'll sync again after the staging run.
